title: Indo-Islamic architecture: more styles and monuments

boxes.title: Dynasty styles: added detail
head: Dynasty
Features
rows: ==Horse-shoe arch, lotus-bud fringe==; red sandstone + marble inlay
Pointed domes, false arches (Syrian/Byzantine); "==crisis period==" (Mongol threat, finances)

boxes.title: Style & firsts: more
items: Ancient India used ==**dry-stone**== masonry; Sultanate used **rubble** in lime
**Pendentive** also turns square to dome; decoration: geometric, **Quranic calligraphy**
Balban's tomb: ==first purely Indo-Islamic tomb== (other list)
Alai Darwaza: first building on fully Islamic principles; gateway of Quwwat-ul-Islam

boxes.title: More monuments
head: Monument
Builder / note
rows: ==Reused temple pillars==; first major Sultanate mosque

boxes.title: Qutb complex: more
items: Aibak began Minar c. **1199**; **Sikandar Lodi** also repaired it
Top storeys in marble + sandstone; some notes: **73 m**
Also: **Alai Minar**, Alauddin's tomb + madrasa, ==**Imam Zamin's tomb**== (APPSC-GS 2019: Alai Darwaza)
Iron Pillar ==resists rust==; in Quwwat-ul-Islam court
Order: Qutb Minar → Tughlaqabad (**1320s**) → Lodi Garden tombs → **Fatehpur Sikri** (**1570s**)

boxes.title: Provincial & Deccan: more
head: Place
Point
rows: Brick, curved roofs; **Eklakhi** tomb, **Dakhil Darwaza**, **Chota Sona Masjid**
Tile mosaic; Firoz Shah Bahmani's has ==Sanskrit inscription==
Capital moved **1592**; piped water; Sultan Quli's mosque inspired Charminar
Onion domes on square bases; style = ==**Indo-Saracenic**==

boxes.title: Other oldest & earliest
items: **Gudimallam**: earliest Shiva Linga; **Lad Khan**, Aihole: early temple
⚠ **Kailasanatha**, Kanchi ==not== the earliest Dravida freestanding temple
**Grand Trunk Road** (Sadak-e-Azam): one of Asia's oldest roads
